item.title: Ownership and Access in Fisheries Production, Processing and Trade
item.content:encoded:
This special issue explores questions of ownership structures and access rights across the fisheries value chain, from production through processing to trade. The focus encompasses how different ownership models and access arrangements shape fisheries systems and outcomes.
